name: What metrics should I track to measure the success of GEO for practice area pages?

mainEntity.name: What metrics should I track to measure the success of GEO for practice area pages?

acceptedAnswer.text: To measure success, track key metrics such as organic search visibility for local keywords, local pack rankings (the map results on Google), website traffic from local searches, and conversion rates for inquiries originating from these pages. Monitor bounce rate and time on page to assess user engagement. Additionally, track calls and direction requests from your Google Business Profile, as these are strong indicators of local search effectiveness. Regularly review these metrics to refine your optimization strategy.
acceptedAnswer.description: Track organic search visibility, local pack rankings, website traffic from local searches, conversion rates, and Google Business Profile interactions.
